arguments.message: When you upgrade to a new phone, the authenticator app generates new codes that don’t match the ones Meridian has on file. To fix this, open the app on your new device and go to **Settings → Security → Two‑factor authentication**. Choose **Reset** and follow the normal setup flow: scan the new QR code and enter the fresh six‑digit code. If you still have a saved recovery code from the original enrollment, you can use it to sign in and reset 2FA from there.
